rules.label: Uninsured self-pay rate (1.25 x AGB)
rules.quote: Uninsured Patients are initially charged the Self-Pay Rate for Covered Services

rules.label: Uninsured Financial Assistance (charged no more than AGB)
rules.quote: you will qualify for BH Financial Assistance (1) if you have an annual household income and household size that is equal to or less than 400% of the Federal Poverty Level and lack other assets to pay the Hospital's full charges

rules.label: Underinsured Financial Assistance (Balance After Insurance discount)
rules.quote: If you are an Underinsured patient, you may qualify for BH Financial Assistance for Underinsured/Balance After Insurance discount

rules.label: Medically Indigent (household medical expenses > 50% of income)
rules.quote: A Medically Indigent Patient means a household with medical expenses incurred during the previous 12 months, where the portion for which the household is responsible exceeds 50% of the household's total income for that year

notes: Policy applies to Banner hospitals and certain other BH entities; not applicable for NHSC locations including Fallon NV, Fernley NV, Susanville CA, Payson Primary Care AZ, Payson OBGYN AZ, Maricopa AZ, Torrington WY, Wheatland WY.
Uninsured patients charged Self-Pay Rate (1.25 x AGB) initially; AGB based on average amounts paid by private insurers and Medicare for medically necessary services.

Uninsured Financial Assistance requires income <= 400% FPL, lack of other assets to pay full charges, and if requested, application for Medicaid/AHCCCS with full cooperation or inability to complete, and denial of coverage.
Underinsured patients must apply for consideration and meet Hospital bill balance requirements and FPL guidelines (specific thresholds not stated in summary).

Qualified patients never charged more than AGB for emergency or medically necessary services; never required to make advance payment for emergency services; for non-emergent services, substantial advance deposit or payment arrangements based on AGB estimate required in most situations.
Medically Indigent definition includes all medical expenses (including non-BH) over previous 12 months; household responsible portion > 50% of total income.

Application requires proof of income (payroll stubs, tax forms, SSA 1099, unemployment letter, self-declaration), Medicaid/AHCCCS determination if requested, and non-Banner medical bills if requested.
Arizona health care lien statute (ARS Sec. 33-931 et seq.) allows Banner Health to recover third-party funding received by patient to offset financial assistance discount.
Spanish translation available on website and in admitting area; copies by mail via Banner Patient Financial Services (888) 264-2127.
No application deadline, ECA timing, first statement timing, or payment plan terms specified in summary.

rules.label: Financial Assistance for Uninsured Patients
rules.quote: If you are an Uninsured patient, you will qualify for BH Financial Assistance (1) if you have an annual household income and household size that is equal to or less than 400% of the Federal Poverty Level and lack other assets to pay the Hospital’s full charges and, (2) if requested to do so by the Hospital, you apply for Medicaid/AHCCCS, fully cooperate in the application and determination process, or are unable to reasonably complete the application process, and are denied Medicaid/AHCCCS coverage.

rules.label: Balance After Insurance Discount for Underinsured Patients
rules.quote: If you are an Underinsured patient, you may qualify for BH Financial Assistance for Underinsured/Balance After Insurance discount. You will need to apply for consideration and meet both Hospital bill balance requirements stated in the Financial Assistance Policy and Federal Poverty Level guidelines.

notes: Uninsured patients not qualifying for Financial Assistance based on FPL may qualify for discounted care at 1.25 x AGB.
Financial Assistance recipients will not be charged more than AGB for emergency or medically necessary services.
No advance payment required for emergency services.
Advance deposit or payment arrangement may be required for non-emergent services.
Policy includes a lien recovery provision per Arizona statute ARS Sec. 33-931 et seq.
